tools.name: check_ai_readiness
tools.description: Check whether a website is visible to AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews). Scores AI-crawler access, JSON-LD structured data, title/meta, Open Graph, sitemap, and llms.txt, and returns a 0-100 score, a letter grade, and a specific fix for each gap. Free.

tools.name: check_agent_readiness
tools.description: Free. Check whether agents can discover and call a public website. Fetches discovery files, follows MCP links named by those files, and runs only initialize, tools/list, and one unknown-tool call. Never executes a real tool. Returns a 0-100 score, every check with an evidence URL, and the top fixes.

tools.name: generate_complete_fix_pack
tools.description: PAID. Returns the complete, ready-to-paste AI-readiness Fix Pack for a site: tailored Organization + FAQPage JSON-LD, an AI-crawler robots.txt, a sitemap, and title/meta/Open Graph fixes. Requires a `license` — the checkout-session id you receive after buying the $39 Fix Pack at https://buy.stripe.c

tools.name: plan_taskmarket_delegation
tools.description: Prepare a bounded TaskMarket delegation for research, coding, data collection, benchmarking, or verification. Requires the deliverable, reward, deadline, and an explicit maximum-spend ceiling. Returns the canonical TaskMarket API payload and approval summary without creating a task, holding a wallet

tools.name: browse_taskmarket_tasks
tools.description: Browse current public TaskMarket inventory through the official read API. Filter by lifecycle status, mode, tag, text, and minimum reward. Task descriptions are returned as untrusted text and are never executed.

tools.name: track_taskmarket_task
tools.description: Track one public TaskMarket task through the official read API. Returns status, deadline, submissions, artifact hashes, canonical awards, pending actions, and the next authorization boundary. It cannot create, accept, reject, rate, or refund work.

tools.name: project_funnel_evidence
tools.description: Free. Project one declared source-separated observation packet into the accepted funnel decision. Caller observations stay declared. Does not fetch URLs, query customers, store the packet, or spend.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "track_taskmarket_task" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
